name: EngineVersion
signature: public readonly record struct EngineVersion : IComparable<EngineVersion>

docs.summary: An engine release like "1.0-preview.5", "1.0", "1.1" or the hotfix "1.1a". Previews sort before their release, hotfixes after it. The default value is the unknown version of a project saved before versions were written.
The hotfix letters, empty for the release itself.
The preview number, zero for the release itself.
